pages.title: Hotel Manager
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description:

Players balance daily operational tasks while upgrading facilities to meet guest satisfaction and financial goals. Key Features

• Resource management gameplay loop  
• Interactive room upgrade system  
• Guest satisfaction level tracking  
• Progressive difficulty scaling  
• Modern hotel environment setting

pages.title: Airport Manager

Key Features

• Flight scheduling and runway management  
• Real-time air traffic control mechanics

• Resource allocation and facility upgrades  
• Airport operations simulation environment
